name: RD-Suite
description: RD-Suite is a systematic and unified benchmark suite for ranking distillation models, comprising four large real-world datasets across textual and numeric modalities and two applications: standard distillation and distillation transfer. It provides benchmark results, datasets with teacher scores, and evaluation scripts to facilitate research and reproducibility in ranking distillation.
reputation: A recent benchmark suite for ranking distillation that is useful for reproducible research, but still relatively niche outside the ranking-distillation community.
notes: Includes datasets with teacher scores and evaluation scripts; covers multiple modalities and applications.
